faq.title: FAQ
faq.subtitle: Answers to the most common customer questions.

original.a: No, AROMA DONNA is a student project. Brands and products are fictional; real orders and payments are not accepted.

choose.q: How do I choose a fragrance online?
choose.a: Look at the fragrance family and notes on the product page, or take the Scent finder quiz — it will show suitable options.

concentration.q: What is the difference between EDT, EDP and Parfum?
concentration.a: It is the concentration of aromatic oils: Eau de Toilette is the lightest, Eau de Parfum lasts longer, and Parfum is the richest and most long-lasting.

delivery.a: Courier in Bishkek — 300 KGS (free from 7,000 KGS), regions — 450 KGS (free from 12,000 KGS), pickup — free.

payment.a: No. No payments are processed on the site: only payment on delivery in cash or by card.

promo.q: How do I apply a promo code?
promo.a: Enter the code in the cart and press Apply. Demo codes: AROMA10, DONNA500, WELCOME15. These are not real promotions.

return.a: The demo terms state that an unopened bottle can be returned within 14 days.

account.a: Your account keeps your order history. Without Firebase, registration works in demo mode and stores data only in your browser.

quiz.q: Does the scent quiz use artificial intelligence?
quiz.a: No. It uses clear rules: points are given for matching family, notes, intensity, category and budget.

storage.q: Will my cart be kept after I close the site?
storage.a: Yes. Cart, favorites, language and theme are saved in your browser's localStorage.

errors.denied: No permission to delete the review. Make sure the stage D Firestore rules are published and sign in again.
errors.network: No internet connection. The review was not deleted — check the connection and try again.
errors.failed: Could not delete the review. Please try again.

admins.subtitle: Who can work in the admin panel and who manages access.
admins.ownerOnlyNote: Only the primary administrator can add and remove administrators and hand over the primary role.

roleHint.owner: Manages administrators and can hand over this role to another administrator.
roleHint.admin: Works in the admin panel sections but does not manage access.
roleHint.pending: This administrator has been offered the primary role. It moves over only once they accept it themselves.

list.title: Administrators
list.legacyHint: Access was granted before this section existed. The record works as usual.
list.emptyText: Add an administrator by their account UID.

uid.label: UID
uid.hint: The UID is the account ID in Firebase Authentication. Ask the person to send you their UID — administrators can’t be added by email.
uid.invalid: A UID may contain only Latin letters, digits, “_” and “-”, up to 128 characters.

grant.title: Add an administrator
grant.text: The person must have an account on the site. They will get access to every panel section except administrator management.
grant.labelHint: Shown only in this list — for example, “Manager”. Up to 100 characters.

revoke.title: Remove administrator access?
revoke.text: {{name}} will no longer be able to use the admin panel. Access ends immediately.
revoke.factAccount: Their account, orders and reviews stay as they are.
revoke.factRestore: You can restore access by adding them again by UID.
revoke.confirmCheck: I understand that {{name}} will lose access to the admin panel

blocked.self: You can’t remove your own access.
blocked.owner: The primary administrator’s access can’t be removed.
blocked.pending: This administrator has been offered the primary role. Cancel the offer first.

transfer.offerActionLabel: Offer the primary administrator role to {{name}}
transfer.offerTitle: Hand over the primary administrator role?
transfer.offerText: You are offering the primary administrator role to {{name}}. The role moves over only when they sign in to the panel and accept the offer themselves.
transfer.factAfter: Once they accept, you become a regular administrator: you keep access to the panel sections but can no longer manage administrators.
transfer.factCancel: You can cancel the offer until it is accepted.
transfer.factOne: Only one offer can be active at a time.
transfer.offerConfirmCheck: I understand that I will no longer be the primary administrator once the offer is accepted
transfer.offerDone: Offer sent to {{name}}. The role moves over once they accept.
transfer.outgoingText: You offered the primary administrator role to {{name}}. Until they accept, you remain the primary administrator.
transfer.incomingTitle: You have been offered the primary administrator role
transfer.incomingText: Offer from the primary administrator: {{name}}. If you accept, you will be able to add and remove administrators.
transfer.acceptDone: You are now the primary administrator.
transfer.acceptText: You will become the primary administrator in place of {{name}}.
transfer.factAcceptPrevious: The previous primary administrator stays on as a regular administrator.
transfer.factAcceptLater: You can pass the role on later only the same way — by offering it to another administrator.
transfer.acceptConfirmCheck: I understand that I am becoming the primary administrator and am responsible for panel access

access.ownerOnlyText: Only the primary administrator can see the administrator list and manage access. The other panel sections are available to you as usual.

errors.not-signed-in: You are not signed in. Please sign in again.
errors.invalid-uid: Check the UID: only Latin letters, digits, “_” and “-” are allowed, up to 128 characters.
errors.invalid-label: The label must be 100 characters or fewer.
errors.not-owner: Only the primary administrator can do this.
errors.self: You can’t do this for your own account.
errors.user-not-found: No user with this UID was found. They need to sign up on the site first.
errors.already-admin: This user is already an administrator.
errors.not-admin: This user doesn’t have administrator access — it may already have been removed. Refresh the list.
errors.owner-protected: The primary administrator’s access can’t be removed.
errors.pending-owner: This administrator has been offered the primary role. Cancel the offer first.
errors.offer-exists: An offer has already been sent. Cancel it to offer the role to another administrator.
errors.no-offer: There is no active offer — it may have been cancelled or declined. Refresh the page.
errors.offer-stale: The offer changed while this page was open. Nothing was changed — refresh the page.
errors.candidate-not-admin: The primary role can only be offered to a current administrator.
errors.denied: Firebase rejected the action: insufficient permissions. Refresh the page or sign in again.
errors.network: No internet connection. Nothing was changed.
errors.failed: The action could not be completed. Please try again.
